analysis_name: Structured conditioning versus equal-input generic fusion
model_selection: Validation-protein discovery utility only; never test metrics, held-out participant anchors or external endpoints
final_refit: Per model, maximize mean validation utility across all fold-seed units to select learning rate; median selected epoch at that rate; refit all discovery pairs for each of three seeds; arithmetic mean of probabilities

external.scope: existing two blood CPAP cohorts and existing adult tissue endpoints

interpretation: Post hoc mechanism/capacity comparison within the original discovery-selected universe. Full denotes common-objective structured architecture, not the archived manuscript checkpoint. Native_full is an unmatched-objective reference. No clinical prediction or guaranteed superiority.
